__comment__: Set adc128d818 register 11 (Configuration Register, 0x0B) to 0x0 to enable Mode 0.
Per the adc128d818 datasheet, Mode 0 enables 7 analog input channels (IN0-IN6) and temperature.
According to the hardware device table for this platform, IN0-IN6 pins and temp are populated and actively used
for voltage and temperature monitoring.

Per the adc128d818 datasheet, Mode 1 enables all eight analog input channels (IN0-IN7).
According to the hardware device table for this platform, all IN0-IN7 pins are populated and actively used
for voltage monitoring. Therefore Mode 1 is required to ensure the ADC samples all channels.
